paragraphs.source_en: “Quite so. Even half a share, if one holds it for a thousand years, ought to build three warehouses. You and I, in that respect, are clever men of the present age with no blind spot. But when it comes to this matter, poor Kushami is a pitiable case. When he hears the word stock, the most he can imagine is some cousin of a daikon radish.” So saying, he picked up another piece of yokan and glanced at the master; the master, infected by Meitei’s appetite, also reached toward the plate of sweets. In this world, in all things, whoever takes positive action acquires the right to be imitated by others.

paragraphs.source_en: “Who remembers things said more than ten years ago?
